activity.notes: Rajendra Chola I succeeded Rajaraja I as sole Chola emperor in 1014 and ruled until 1044. Sources also attest a co-regency beginning in 1012; this Activity intentionally records the standard 1014-1044 sole imperial reign rather than conflating the preceding co-regency with the primary reign interval.

sources.title: From the late Chola to early Vijayanagara Empire: Aspects of Kingship and Administration
sources.citation_text: Duy Chinh Nguyen's University of Cologne dissertation identifies the Chola empire as a major South Indian state and gives Rajendra I's reign as 1014-1044, following Rajaraja I (985-1014).

sources.title: Excavation at Gangaikondacholapuram, The Imperial Capital of Rajendra Chola, and Its Significance
sources.citation_text: S. Vasanthi's Cambridge chapter identifies Rajendra Chola as the son of Rajaraja I and treats him as the Chola emperor who expanded and maintained the empire; the chapter also reflects the 1012 co-regency tradition.

sources.title: The Cholas — Outlines of Indian History
sources.citation_text: The INFLIBNET history module lists Rajendra I as ruler from 1014 to 1044 and describes the continued Chola expansion under his reign.
